verdict.rationale: Self-hosting via Docker is explicitly documented as free, GitHub repo confirms full local operation with no accounts/API keys required, and multiple community reports (HN) corroborate hands-on self-hosted/desktop deployments, including troubleshooting details, showing this is a real, working capability rather than just a claim. Missing for 10: no independent enterprise-scale self-host audit or benchmark of the Docker deployment beyond community anecdotes.
